name: Braided hammock pair
idea: A quiet pair-building shelter suspends two collaborators in a shared work hammock, derived from interwoven rounded ribs and tensioned fabric rather than a single shell or vertical monolith.
shape_ancestry: two inflated crescent ribs braid around a suspended upholstered hammock, forming a soft figure-eight with a central oval cavity and no enclosing pod wall
silhouette: two counter-curving ribs cross into a broad horizontal figure-eight, with the hammock hanging in the central opening and one tail lifted above the other
exaggeration: make the upper rib's crossing arc much larger than the lower cradle and exaggerate the open central cavity so the negative space defines the silhouette
aperture_rule: the central oval cavity is the shared entry and work aperture; a small rounded skylight follows the upper rib, with no flat windshield or screen-first surface
construction_cues: one woven warm-metal tension band joins the two ribs at the crossing
one deep upholstered hammock explains paired occupancy and rest
one rounded docking shoe grounds the lower rib without exposed wheels
material_direction: blush and mineral-blue lacquered ribs, translucent amber resin skylight, warm chrome tension band, caramel upholstery, and softly grainy illustrated shading
